title: Converting between fractions, decimals and percentages
subtitle: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can convert fluently between fractions, decimals and percentages.

key_vocab.definition: Converting means writing a number in a DIFFERENT form without changing its value. Fractions, decimals and percentages are three ways to write the same amount.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can convert fluently between fractions, decimals and percentages.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Converting -- Converting means writing a number in a DIFFERENT form without changing its value. Fractions, decimals and percentages are three ways to write the same amount.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Fraction → Decimal: divide top by bottom. Decimal → Percentage: × 100. Percentage → Fraction: write over 100 and simplify.
⅜ → 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375 → 37.5%
Divide, then multiply by 100

Key examples:
  ✓ ½ = 0.5 = 50%  (all equivalent)
  ✓ ¼ = 0.25 = 25%  (all equivalent)
  ✓ ⅗ = 0.6 = 60%  (all equivalent)
  ✗ ⅓ = 0.3 = 30%  (0.3 ≠ ⅓)
  ✗ 0.7 = 70% = &frac{7}{70}  (should be 7/10)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – fraction to decimal
  Convert ¾ to a decimal
  3 ÷ 4
  = 0.75
  ✓
  = 0.75
  (Divide numerator by denominator: 3 ÷ 4 = 0.75)

Example 2 – decimal to percentage
  Convert 0.35 to a percentage
  0.35 × 100
  = 35
  Add % sign
  = 35%
  (Multiply the decimal by 100 and add the % symbol.)

sections.title: Fraction to decimal
sections.content:
Convert each fraction to a decimal by dividing the numerator by the denominator.

(a) ½
(b) ⅕
(c) ⅜
(d) &frac{7}{20}

sections.title: Decimal to percentage
sections.content:
Convert each decimal to a percentage by multiplying by 100.

(a) 0.4
(b) 0.75
(c) 0.08
(d) 0.125

sections.title: Percentage to fraction
sections.content:
Convert each percentage to a fraction in its simplest form. Write over 100 then simplify.

(a) 20%
(b) 60%
(c) 35%
(d) 84%

sections.title: Fraction to percentage
Mixed conversions
sections.content:
Convert each value to the other two forms (fraction, decimal, percentage).

(a) 0.6 = ___ = ___%
(b) 72% = ___ = ___
(c) &frac{9}{25} = ___ = ___%
(d) 0.875 = ___ = ___%
(e) 5% = ___ = ___
